name: regulating synaptic membrane exocytosis 1

function.text: RIMS1 is the approved symbol for regulating synaptic membrane exocytosis 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in GTPase regulator activity; small GTPase binding; acrosomal vesicle exocytosis.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
